Class MonoBehaviour

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.models.MonoBehaviour

  • public abstract class MonoBehaviour
extends Component
    Base class for user-defined behaviors attached to GameObjects.

    Extend MonoBehaviour to implement custom logic for initialization and per-frame updates.
